evidence_basis.source: Nakamura, Sudo & Sugisaki (2021), BOJ IMES Discussion Paper 2021-E-2
evidence_basis.implication: A 30-minute monetary-policy announcement window in Japan is literature-grounded; the paper uses 10 minutes before through 20 minutes after the MPM announcement.
BOJ MPM releases have minute-scale effects on Nikkei 225 implied volatility and VI futures; 5-10 minute effects motivate minute data but are not separately optimized in G1.

event_data.eligibility_rule: Both baseline [-40,-10) and event [-10,+20) windows must fall fully inside the same historical OSE continuous day-session segment.

measurement.bar_label_semantics: Minute-start grid, verified by source labels spanning official open through close-1 minute on Mini and Micro samples.
measurement.return_definition: For minute-start label t, r_t = log(C_t / C_{t-1}) using contiguous source 1-minute closes within the same OSE session.
measurement.cloud_output: Per-event non-reconstructive aggregate RV/effect features + hashes/manifest only.

stage_a.pass_rule: Minimum usable event count met, mean effect > 0, median effect > 0, and event bootstrap P(mean effect > 0) >= 0.95.
stage_a.fail_rule: If Stage A fails, Stage B is prohibited and Micro cannot rescue the family.

stage_b.test: Identical transform and gate as Stage A; no retuning.
stage_b.pass_rule: Minimum usable event count met, mean effect > 0, median effect > 0, and event bootstrap P(mean effect > 0) >= 0.95.
stage_b.interpretation_if_pass: Stage 3 true-target event/risk information-state candidate only; any size reduction, entry blackout, stop widening, or confidence rule requires separate downstream translation and validation.

diagnostics_non_promotional: 5-minute aggregation consistency may be reported as measurement QA only.
Year-by-year effect direction may be reported for stability context only.
Absolute event return may be reported descriptively but has no G1 promotion power.

multiplicity.correction: None needed for one primary outcome/window; diagnostics cannot rescue or promote.

forbidden: Change the [-10,+20) primary event window after outcome inspection.
Try 5m/10m/20m/60m windows and select the best.
Split events by weather in G1.
Classify policy surprise after outcomes and rescue a failed aggregate family.
Use directional returns as G1 alpha.
Change 1-minute primary measurement because 5-minute QA looks better.
Allow Micro Stage B to rescue a failed Mini Stage A.
next_if_pass: Only after Stage A and Stage B PASS may BOJ MPM be admitted as an event/risk information-state candidate. Position/risk-control rules are new families/stages.
next_if_fail: Close current family. Reopen only with substantively new literature/evidence, not parameter rescue.
